generation.scope: All twenty generic marks on the fifteen-dimensional component admit rational mixed-bracket reconstruction and are separated, with all four starts, by two explicit covariants. Two nine-word bases give root-free complete marked invariants, and interpolation over a degree-twenty finite etale algebra gives complete rational unmarked invariants on the open chart. There the projective automorphism group is trivial and the minimum period is four. Every lift in a specified 1009-adic congruence ball is all-degree AS by good reduction, with a fifteen-parameter analytic slice of pairwise nonisomorphic windows and Zariski-dense algebraic regular realizations.

open_mathematics: Study the boundary of the high-rank marked reconstruction where the trace or product ranks drop. Start at the transverse mixed curve and its period-two involution. Determine the actual mixed bracket fibers there via reversal and its positive-dimensional linear kernels, then relate to remaining all-degree and unmarked coverage problems.
